_comment: Per-document metadata for the RAG corpus. Keys must match the PDF filenames
`url` is rendered on every citation badge in the dashboard and a judge will
click one, so it must be a real, live, deep link to the document -- not the
CERC homepage. `effective_date` and `doc_name` are copied onto every chunk.
`clause_prefix` is what a bare heading number is called in this document.
CERC notifications number 'Regulations'; the Grid Code numbers 'Clauses'.
Emitting the wrong word would make the citation itself inaccurate.
The filename carries the year, and the retriever reads it to honour the
regulation-year slider: with rule_year=2024, a document named _2025 is
Run scripts/hash_regulations.py after adding a PDF to fill in sha256/bytes.

CERC_DSM_Regulations_2024.pdf.title: CERC (Deviation Settlement Mechanism and Related Matters) Regulations, 2024
CERC_DSM_Regulations_2024.pdf.note: The principal regulations. Contains the deviation formula, the tolerance bands, the normal rate of charges, and the X-trajectory from 01.04.2026.

CERC_DSM_Amendment_2025.pdf.title: CERC (Deviation Settlement Mechanism and Related Matters) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025

CERC_DSM_StatementOfReasons_2024.pdf.title: Statement of Reasons -- CERC (Deviation Settlement Mechanism and Related Matters) Regulations, 2024
CERC_DSM_StatementOfReasons_2024.pdf.note: Not operative law. It records the Commission's reasoning on each provision, which answers 'why is the rule this way' questions the notification itself does not.
